api/api/GameFramework.Core.DiContainer.h.summary: Class DiContainer Enhanced dependency injection container with automatic constructor injection support. Supports singleton registration, factory registration, type bindings, and automatic dependency resolution. Inheritance object DiContainer Inherited Members object.Equals(object) object.Equals(object, object) object.GetHashCode() object.GetType() object.MemberwiseClone() object.ReferenceEquals(object, object) object.ToString() Namespace: GameFramework.Core Assembly: .dll Syntax public class DiContainer Remarks This DI container provides three main registration patterns: Singleton: One instance created and reused for all requests Transient: New instance created for each request Factory: Custom factory function called for each request The container automatically resolves constructor dependencies using reflection, selecting the constructor with the most parameters and recursively resolving all dependencies. Circular dependency detection prevents infinite resolution loops. Design Benefits: Clean separation of concerns, automatic dependency resolution, easy testing, loose coupling Trade-offs: Runtime dependency resolution, potential circular dependencies, reflection overhead Examples // Register services container.RegisterSingleton<ILogger, ConsoleLogger>(); container.RegisterTransient<IRepository, DatabaseRepository>(); container.RegisterFactory<IConnection>(() => new SqlConnection(connectionString)); // Resolve services (automatic constructor injection) var service = container.Resolve<IMyService>(); Properties Instance Gets the singleton instance of the DI container. Declaration public static DiContainer Instance { get; } Property Value Type Description DiContainer The singleton DIContainer instance. Remarks Creates a new instance on first access. The container is designed to be used as a singleton to maintain consistent service registrations across the application. Methods Clear() Clears all registrations from the container.
